OKAFOR STRATEGIC CONSULTING — SUPPORTING SCHEDULE
Prepared by: Denise Pruitt, CPA (Pruitt & Cole Tax Advisory)
Re: Reconciliation of Piedmont Trust Bank Account #...4471 Deposits, Tax Year 2022
Prepared: May 19, 2025 (post-petition, for Appeals/Tax Court submission)

Total deposits per bank statements, calendar year 2022 ................ $186,400.00
Gross receipts reported on 2022 Schedule C .............................$138,800.00
Difference (per Revenue Agent Report, treated as unreported income) ....$ 47,600.00

Reconciliation of the $47,600 difference:

  1. Transfer from Okafor joint savings account (Piedmont Trust
     acct ending 2290) on 03/11/2022, 06/02/2022, and 09/14/2022 ....... $23,200.00
     Source: already-taxed W-2 wages of Diane R. Okafor, deposited into
     savings in prior years, later moved into the business checking
     account to cover a payroll shortfall. See attached savings account
     statements (Exhibit A, provided separately).

  2. Repayment of personal loan from Gerald T. Wynn, received in three
     installments (04/01/2022, 07/01/2022, 10/01/2022) ................ $14,000.00
     Source: Michael Okafor loaned Mr. Wynn $14,000 in March 2021
     (see signed promissory note dated 03/02/2021, Exhibit B). The 2022
     deposits are repayment of principal only; no interest was charged.

  3. Duplicate/rounding overlap between two same-day merchant deposits
     misread as separate items during the exam .......................$ 6,200.00

  4. Unreconciled / unable to document source ..........................$ 4,200.00

Total reconciled as non-income ..........................................$43,400.00
Remaining unreconciled amount ...........................................$ 4,200.00

Conclusion: Of the $47,600 the Revenue Agent Report treated as unreported gross receipts, we are
able to substantiate a non-taxable source for $43,400. We recommend the disputed unreported-income
adjustment be reduced from $47,600 to $4,200 pending any further documentation on the remaining
balance.
